result.topic_en: Dedekind studies a pair of simultaneous congruences mod 1 for rational pairs (ρ,σ), (ρ_1,σ_1), determines the gcd p = [w, w_1, w_2] of the denominators and parametrizes the solutions x, x_1, with greatest-common-divisor relations among the denominators; the math is written over a faint, unrelated handwritten legal text.

methods.what: Reduction of the congruence system mod 1 to integer denominators w, w_1 with numerators u, v, u_1, v_1
Introduction of h via a linear combination with gcd 1, giving hy ≡ y_1
Definition of the modulus p as the gcd of the conditions on y
Proof that p equals the gcd of w, w_1, w_2 through mutual divisibility

methods.quote: $x = \frac{w}{p} z$ ; $x_1 = h\frac{w_1}{p} z + w_1 z_1$ ; $x, z_1$ ganz.
